faqs.q: How can I contact the ditch company?
faqs.a: Contact information for the main three ditches in Arvada is available on the City’s irrigation ditches webpage. Other ditch companies may have websites or contact information online. If you cannot find information online, please reach out to the City through Ask Arvada and a team member will try to assist you.
